note: The one code table of the flight recorder (schema mml-recorder/1). XEXPL-01's explanation layers will read the same table. A code the recorder is given that is not listed here is counted in unknown_codes (the recorder test requires zero) and still written as given. 'not evaluated' is the value stored for anything the engine did not compute; nothing is invented.

entity_kinds.p: person: p:<permanent person id> (ID-01); the current player character is p:<PlayerState.pid>, marked by the participant role suffix :player, never a separate identity; p:player only if a player has no pid (a bare test world)
entity_kinds.role: an office that passes from person to person: role:player is held by one person at a time (changes at succession)
entity_kinds.inv: an inventory whose owner the recorder could not name
entity_kinds.tie: a pair's relationship, tie:<lower id>:<higher id> (Relations.key; a player tie uses their person id, -2 the host)

alert_rules.coin.unattributed_holder: a holder's coins changed by an amount no recorded coin state change explains
alert_rules.identity.ids_changed_on_load: a version 20 save was loaded and the set of person ids differs from the saved register
alert_rules.coin.unattributed_total: World.total_coins changed by an amount neither the recorded coin changes nor World.coin_sources explain

reasons.not_feasible: the live decision code marked the candidate infeasible (its own words are the factor row why)
reasons.invalid_trade: quantity or price not valid, or buyer and seller the same
reasons.buyer_short_of_coins: the buyer's purse was below the bill
reasons.seller_lacks_item: the seller did not hold the units
reasons.buyer_inventory_full: the buyer could not take the item
reasons.from_lacks_item: the giving inventory did not hold the units
reasons.to_cannot_take: the receiving inventory could not take the item
reasons.act_returned_false: the action returned false; the code gives no finer reason
reasons.no_path: the path search found no route
reasons.no_level_route: no portal leads to the step's level
reasons.station_wait_exceeded: waited the station wait limit for the player to finish at a station
reasons.guard_or_planner_declined: the branch's guard was false or its planner returned no plan; the chain does not say which
reasons.treasury_short: the manor's treasury could not pay
reasons.refused_by_rules: the action's own rules refused it (the reason is in the detail)
reasons.too_far: the player was out of reach
reasons.pack_full: the player's pack could not take the item
reasons.nothing_to_take: the container held nothing to pick
reasons.recognised: the buyer recognised the goods as their own stolen property
reasons.questioned: a guard questioned the player about stolen goods
reasons.sale_failed: the sale did not go through
reasons.buy_failed: the purchase did not go through
reasons.craft_refused: the craft could not be done
reasons.target_gone: fight(): the target died, left the level, or (an NPC target) went into another building
reasons.bandit_low_hp: fight(): a bandit below 30% health breaks off
reasons.out_of_range: fight(): the target was more than 25 tiles away
reasons.near_bandit_camp: fight(): a guard's target was within 12 tiles of the bandit camp
reasons.blocked: fight(): the straight-line chase step landed in a solid cell (SIM-F4): the chase is given up; the corner case of GP-CRIME-PURSUIT
reasons.robbed: fight(): a bandit robbed its victim and went back to the camp
reasons.target_slain: fight(): the fighter's blow killed the target
reasons.cleared_elsewhere: the target was cleared by other code (the player's death, a kill, a reset); seen at the next hour
reasons.retargeted: the fighter was given a different target before this chase ended
reasons.lost_sight: fight(): a guard on a player's case lost sight of them (A2): the search of the last-known place begins; the case stays open
reasons.case_closed: fight() or the search: the case ended (the offender died, yielded or was taken in; A2, A3)
reasons.searched: the search of the last-known place and around it found nothing in its time (A2): the case goes over to wanted
reasons.yielded: the offender yielded to the guards (A3): fined, the stolen goods returned
reasons.taken: a guard who may not kill beat the offender down and took them in (A3): fined, the stolen goods returned
reasons.not_reached: an earlier branch took the decision, so this branch (alternative option "after:<winner>" stands for every later branch of the chain) was not evaluated
